Bug_Title: MS: Field is a mutable collection which should be package protected (MS_MUTABLE_COLLECTION_PKGPROTECT)
Bug_Details:
A mutable collection instance is assigned to a final static field,
  thus can be changed by malicious code or by accident from another package.
  The field could be made package protected to avoid this vulnerability.
  Alternatively you may wrap this field into Collections.unmodifiableSet/List/Map/etc.
  to avoid this vulnerability.
Bug_Explanation: A mutable collection (ArrayList) is assigned to a public static final field, allowing it to be modified from outside the class. The field should be made package protected to avoid this vulnerability.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by directly modifying the mutable BUGGY_LIST returned by the showBug method.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the bug. The test code successfully adds an item to the BUGGY_LIST, which is a mutable collection that is publicly accessible and final. This violates the bug rule, as it allows for the collection to be modified from outside the package, which could lead to unintended changes or vulnerabilities.
